t: The Fortress Trade 2" Short Handle Paint Brush is engineered for precise cutting-in, an essential decorating tool for detailed work around skirting boards, architraves, and window frames. It features angled, synthetic bristles and solid, round tapered filaments, offering superb paint load capacity and excellent control with all paint types. Mixed filaments significantly reduce tramlines for a smooth, professional finish. A rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule ensures durability, and the ergonomic handle provides comfortable use. This paint brush is also quick and easy to clean, enhancing efficiency on any painting project.
